column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# The rolling dev pre-release (tag dev, commit 21a4f1e) is the newest and only published build;
# no v* tag exists and no predecessor repo shipped this mod. Its installer ZIP (plugins/), its
# Nexus ZIP and its launcher manifest seed all hold the same PacificDriveHeadTracking.ini, and no
# build wrote one on its first run: every player's file is that one, edited or not.
# The reader was frozen at b8ac5e2, whose src/ is 21a4f1e's. No commit since changes how the
# file is read, and every core source either reader compiles holds the same bytes at 7820a8c
# (the dev build's core pin) and at the current pin.

column2: dev:PacificDriveHeadTracking.ini, the file the dev installer ZIP, Nexus ZIP and manifest seed ship, tests/config_differential/data/shipped-dev.ini
